data.text:
LOOK: LENTE attends 2nd Hearing of the House 
Committee on Suffrage and Electoral Reforms.  LENTE Executive Director Atty. Ona Caritos was one of the resource persons for the Committee’s 2nd hearing to discuss bills related to Early Voting for vulnerable and other sectors and nuisance candidates.   

Election accessibility and inclusivity being one of LENTE’s longstanding reform advocacies, Atty. Ona highlighted LENTE’s support for the Early Voting Bills. In addition, and citing LENTE’s time and motion study and previous technical work, Atty. Ona proposed that the Committee consider widening the sectors who can avail of the early voting privilege and open it to all qualified voters as this will have the most impact in terms of easing election congestion as well as make it more cost-effective.
